reports.notes: Handwritten in black ink, block capitals. Political Party glyph reads 'RED' (three block letters R-E-D); it may be the filer's abbreviation for Republican but the third letter is written as a D, so it is transcribed exactly as it appears at LOW confidence - not normalized. Line 3 'Balance at Beginning' is written '$3446' with NO decimal point legible and the form's printed black arrow graphic overlapping its right edge; the four digits 3446 are transcribed verbatim at low confidence (the filer's own lines 4 and 5 would be consistent with 34.46, but no decimal is printed and nothing was arithmetic-derived here). Line 2 Column A is written as '1500' with a raised superscript '00' for cents (transcribed 1500.00); the dollar sign there is overwritten/struck. Line 7 is a single slashed-zero glyph, transcribed 0 at medium confidence. County date stamp OCT 27 PM12:31. CORRECTION 2026-08-20 (re-read at the source, page 2 rendered at 200 dpi): line 3 'Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period' PRINTS `$3446` with NO decimal point — the glyphs are faithfully recorded in totals_verbatim and are NOT changed. The VALUE is 34.46, proved three independent ways by the document itself and its predecessor, per the GOTCHAS cardinal rule that ARITHMETIC CLOSURE OUTRANKS GLYPH READING: (1) line 5 'Subtotal (Add lines 3 and 4)' prints 1,500.00 against line 4's 1,465.54, requiring line 3 = 34.46; (2) line 7 'Balance at Close' prints 0 and 1,500.00 - 1,500.00 = 0 closes exactly, which 3,446 + 1,465.54 = 4,911.54 does not; (3) the SAME FILER's prior report (raw/2014/2014_6-14Rec-Smith.pdf) closes at line 7 = 34.46, and the form prints an arrow beside line 3 reading 'Refer to Line 7 on your last report'. This is the FILER omitting a decimal point, not a transcription defect. stated_beginning_balance therefore publishes 34.46 while the verbatim `3446` is retained here.

itemized.escalation_note: ⚠ ONE ESCALATION THAT MATTERS BEYOND THIS RECORD — the p2 line 3 'Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period' cell. At full-page resolution the handwriting reads as '$3446' with no visible separator, and that is how it was captured in the earlier cover-totals tranche (this module's published stated_beginning_balance for this filing is 3446). A 1200 dpi tight crop (pct:57,58.5,18,6.5@p2) resolves a decimal point between the '34' and the '46', and THE LADDER SETTLES IT REGARDLESS: line 5 'Subtotal (Add lines 3 and 4)' is printed as $1,500.00 and line 4 is 1,465.54, so line 3 can only be 34.46 — 3,446 would make line 5 read 4,911.54. ARITHMETIC CLOSURE OUTRANKS GLYPH READING (GOTCHAS, the Rhodes reversal): the beginning balance is 34.46. This is reported to the coordinator as a candidate correction to the published cover figure; nothing outside this record was edited. Second escalation: a 700 dpi crop (pct:57,75,18,12@p2) rendered line 6 as '$1,500.00' and line 7 as a single hand-drawn ZERO GLYPH — an oval with a diagonal stroke through it — which under the zero-glyph ruling reads 0 and closes the ladder.

itemized.notes: A ONE-ROW-PER-SIDE FILING and the cleanest arithmetic in the chunk: a single self-contribution in, a single consulting payment out, and the account closes at zero. 4 pages classified from their own printed headings: p1 cover ('2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES'), p2 'SUMMARY PAGE', p3 'SCHEDULE A — ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED', p4 'SCHEDULE B — ITEMIZED EXPENDITURES MADE'. Both schedules are on the 2014 template ('Address, City & Zip'; 'Purchased From/Source'), unlike Ratcliffe's same-cycle filing, which uses the older schedule sheets. PAGE-FACE candidate 'JEFFERY DEAN SMITH' in block capitals; office written 'COUNTY RECORDER', agreeing with the channel; index.csv names no candidate, so the page face supplies it. ⚠ THE POLITICAL PARTY FIELD READS 'RED' — three block letters, unambiguous at full-page resolution. It is transcribed as printed and NOT adjudicated: it may be this filer's shorthand for the Republican Party, or the name of a party, and the brief forbids resolving a filer's own idiosyncrasy for him. No party is inferred. Report type ticked 'Seven days preceding the General Election'; amendment 'No' ticked; signed 10/27/2014; clerk's date stamp 'OCT 27 PM12:31'. FOLIATION: 'Page 1 of 3' / '2 of 3' / '3 of 3' with 'SMITH' and '10/27/14' on each sheet — cover EXCLUDED (as Buhman and Poulson do, and as Lee does not). ⚠ CANDIDATE CORRECTION FOR THE COORDINATOR, evidence in escalation_note: this module's published stated_beginning_balance for this filing is 3446; the page's own ladder proves the cell is 34.46 (34.46 + 1,465.54 = the printed line-5 subtotal 1,500.00). Nothing outside this record was edited. PRIVACY: this filing is NOT redacted — the county published the candidate's own address block and the donor's address in the clear; the reduction to city/state is mine at read time per Addendum A §A5. TWO CONTINUATION-LINE CASES appear in this chunk and both are on 2014 filings (Lee's 'In Kind donation / from Reagan outdoor Digital Signs' with the amount on the SECOND row, and this filing's 'LISA SHEPARD / CONSULTING' with the amount on the FIRST) — the row index must follow the AMOUNT, and the two cases point in opposite directions, so it cannot be assumed.
